sources.title: Living on the edge of effective field theory: Near-extremal black holes in quadratic gravity
sources.comparator_role: near-extremal background, regularity and EFT-validity controls
reported_observations: dCS fixed-surface-gravity/fixed-horizon-angular-velocity family approaches an asymptotically flat extremal exterior with a deformed NHEK limit
sGB family develops logarithmic scalar horizon behaviour and a near-horizon boundary layer
finite scalar curvature invariants can coexist with divergent infalling-observer tidal forces
sources.transfer_limit: Do not generalize theory-specific dCS/sGB conclusions to pure Weyl gravity.

sources.title: Quadratic gravity corrections to scalar quasinormal modes of rapidly rotating black holes
sources.comparator_role: matched scalar test-field QNM validation only

sources.title: Neural-spectral discovery of rotating black holes beyond general relativity
sources.comparator_role: neural discovery plus pseudo-spectral refinement method
sources.transfer_limit: Demonstrated higher-dimensional quadratic/cubic-curvature settings are not a matched 4D pure-Weyl benchmark.

claim_ceiling: A passing benchmark qualifies only the declared theory, branch, parameter range, chart, observer family and EFT truncation. It does not establish UV completion, global stability or observational viability.
